# Husker Radio Finder

> Find the closest Nebraska Huskers radio station to your location using GPS

## Overview

Husker Radio Finder is a free web tool that helps Nebraska Huskers fans find the closest AM and FM radio stations broadcasting football, volleyball, and basketball games near their current location. The app uses GPS/geolocation to calculate distances to actual FCC radio tower locations and displays results sorted by proximity.

For the 2026-27 seasons, more than 50 Husker Radio Network stations broadcast on 60+ AM/FM frequencies across Nebraska, South Dakota, and Kansas: football on about 60 station frequencies, volleyball on about 45, men's basketball on about 50, and women's basketball on about 35.

## Key Features

- GPS-based finder for the closest Husker radio station to you right now
- Interactive map showing station locations and user position
- Sort by distance or by what should sound best at your location (estimated signal strength, with FM favored over AM at similar strength for its clearer audio)
- Filter by sport: Football, Volleyball, Men's Basketball, Women's Basketball
- 50+ stations / 60+ frequencies across Nebraska, South Dakota, and Kansas
- No account required, completely free, privacy-focused (location stays on device)

## Major Husker Radio Stations (2026-27)

- KLIN 1400 AM / 99.3 FM - Lincoln, NE (football flagship)
- KRVN 880 AM - Lexington, NE (rural Nebraska flagship, 50,000 watts)
- WOW 590 AM - Omaha, NE (football, volleyball, basketball) - primary Omaha station and new Omaha metro home for Husker athletics starting fall 2026, announced July 2026 (see https://www.walnutmediausa.com/am-590-wow-historic-signal-returns and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/WOW_(AM)); may not yet appear on huskers.com/listen
- KOBM 97.3 FM - Omaha, NE (football, volleyball)
- KCRO 660 AM - Omaha, NE (volleyball, basketball) - secondary Omaha station, carries games when schedules conflict
- KBBK 107.3 FM - Lincoln, NE (volleyball, women's basketball)
- Inside Memorial Stadium, the Husker Radio Network feed is on 87.7 FM

## How It Works

1. User clicks "Find Nearest Stations" button
2. Browser requests GPS location permission
3. App calculates distance from user to each radio tower using haversine formula
4. Results display the 15 nearest stations sorted by distance
5. Interactive map shows station markers and auto-zooms to relevant area

## Common Questions

Q: What radio channel is the Nebraska game on?
A: It depends on where you are — Husker football airs on about 60 stations across NE, SD, and KS. In Lincoln tune to KLIN 1400 AM or 99.3 FM; in Omaha tune to WOW 590 AM (new for 2026) or KOBM 97.3 FM. Use huskerfinder.sheetsj.com to find the closest station to any location.

Q: What is the closest Husker football radio station to me right now?
A: Use the Husker Radio Finder at huskerfinder.sheetsj.com — it uses GPS to list the nearest stations sorted by actual distance to each station's FCC tower.

Q: What is the flagship radio station for Nebraska Huskers?
A: KLIN 1400 AM in Lincoln and KRVN 880 AM in Lexington are major flagship stations for the Huskers Radio Network.

Q: Can I listen to Nebraska volleyball on the radio?
A: Yes, about 45 stations broadcast Nebraska volleyball in 2026, including KBBK 107.3 FM in Lincoln and KCRO 660 AM and WOW 590 AM in Omaha.

Q: How many radio stations broadcast Husker games?
A: More than 50 stations on 60+ AM/FM frequencies broadcast Nebraska Huskers games across Nebraska, South Dakota, and Kansas for the 2026-27 seasons.

Q: What station is the Husker game on inside Memorial Stadium?
A: The Husker Radio Network feed is available on 87.7 FM inside Memorial Stadium in Lincoln.

## Technical Details

- Static web application (HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript)
- Uses Leaflet.js for interactive mapping
- Station coordinates from FCC tower database
- FM signal strength from FCC F(50,50) propagation curves (licensed ERP + antenna HAAT); AM from a Norton groundwave model with Great Plains soil conductivity, using licensed day or night power depending on local sunset/sunrise
